INSERT INTO feature_flags (id, `key`, enabled, rollout_percentage, description, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES
  (1, 'lesson_progress_bar',       1, 100, 'Shows a progress bar on the /lessons hub indicating how many lessons a student has completed', NOW(), NOW()),
  (2, 'assumption_family_arc_cta', 1, 100, 'Shows a direct CTA button at the end of the Sufficient Assumptions lesson linking to Flaw in the Reasoning', NOW(), NOW()),
  (3, 'about_testimonials',        1, 100, 'Shows the What Students Say testimonials section on the About page', NOW(), NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  enabled            = VALUES(enabled),
  rollout_percentage = VALUES(rollout_percentage),
  description        = VALUES(description),
  updated_at         = NOW();
